incident.codename: CENTRAL FREIGHT DERAILMENT & CHEMICAL TANKER RUPTURE
incident.type: Train Derailment / Toxic Inhalation / Structural Collapse
incident.summary: High-speed freight train derailment with 3 overturned pressurized ammonia tankers and catastrophic structural collapse of adjacent warehouse complex. 214 casualties reported across 3 primary impact sectors.

events.title: Freight Train Derailment Reported
events.detail: 911 calls report locomotive derailment, multi-car pileup, and structural collapse at Central Logistics corridor.

events.title: Mass Casualty Incident Level 3 Declared
events.detail: Battalion Chief 4 establishes unified on-scene command. Mutual aid alert triggered.

events.title: 214 Casualties Estimated
events.detail: Field triage reports 31 Red, 67 Yellow, 82 Green, and 34 Unknown in structural collapse zones.

events.title: Hospital Bed Capacity Sweep Completed
events.detail: Regional EMR telemetry returns only 4 available ICU beds across Metro Trauma (2), St. Jude (1), and Harborview (1).

events.title: Highway 101 South Severed at Overpass 4
events.detail: Collapsed gantry debris blocks road corridor. Rerouting traffic via Grand Ave (+14m detour).

events.title: Ambulance Fleet Capacity Exhausted
events.detail: All 5 emergency units committed. 27 critical casualties lack immediate transport allocation.

events.title: Crisis Standards of Care Threshold Reached
events.detail: Critical patient load exceeds available regional ICU capacity by a factor of 7.75x.

recommendations.title: DECLARE CRISIS STANDARDS OF CARE
recommendations.explanation: Regional ICU capacity deficit is extreme: 31 critical casualties competing for 4 available ICU beds (7.75x deficit). Authorizing crisis standards of care permits reverse triage, expediting the discharge of stabilized ward patients to free critical care monitors and nursing staff.

recommendations.title: REQUEST STATE MUTUAL AID (REGION II TIER 3)
recommendations.explanation: The municipal ambulance fleet is 100% committed (5 of 5 units). 27 critical red-triage patients remain unassigned at the scene. Requesting 15 mutual-aid ALS transport units from adjacent county will reduce the arrival gap by 42 minutes.
recommendations.suggested_action: Transmit Automated Mutual Aid Dispatch Call

recommendations.title: AIR-MEDICAL CASUALTY EVACUATION
recommendations.explanation: Highway 101 is severed at Overpass 4 (+14 min detour). Dispatching Medevac 1 to the Industrial Park helipad allows direct aerial transport of 2 severe pediatric burn/crush casualties to Harborview Memorial, completely bypassing road bottlenecks.
